Error.description: Any failure, in the one envelope.

setPasswordUrl.description: A new account's single-use link. Shown once; nothing keeps it.

prefix.description: The first characters of the secret, to tell keys apart.

jobId.description: The progress id the browser subscribes to.

total.description: Active projects the job will archive.

contentType.description: Sniffed from the bytes, never the client's claim.

url.description: A signed download URL valid for a few minutes; fetch the record again for a fresh one.

AuditEntry.description: One audit entry as the kernel wrote it (ADR-0013): both snapshots, the actor and whoever they acted for.

ConflictDetails.description: error.details of a 409: both versions, so the client can offer reload, overwrite or diff.

permissions.description: A non-empty subset of the permissions modules declare.

events.description: Event names, e.g. example.project.created. At least one.

url.description: https:// only - the payload is signed, not encrypted.

Error.description: The one failure shape every endpoint returns. Branch on error.code; error.message is translated and may change.

ImpersonatedSession.description: The person's session body (identity's Session) with `impersonating: true` and `operator: {id, displayName}`. No refresh cookie is set.

tenantId.description: The workspace to open; the best active membership otherwise.

consultants.description: Who serves it, by name or address.

titleKey.description: A translation key the client renders with `context` as arguments; the type itself when the type is no longer declared.

token.description: HS256 access token, aud manager, 15 minutes. No refresh: a lapsed session means logging in again.

value.description: Any JSON value; null is a value, not an absence.

ProgressJob.description: A job as useProgress reads it: polled here, pushed on /tenants/{tid}/progress/{id} in the same shape.

attributes.description: Open-ended per-tenant data (ADR-0012): a JSONB column, not a custom-fields layer.

version.description: Optimistic-locking version. Send it back as If-Match.

clientReference.description: Encrypted at rest; plaintext only here, never in the list.

Registered.description: The same for every address: no ids, because an address that already has an account must not be told so (ADR-0023).

excerpt.description: A highlighted fragment of the indexed text - content, which is why the type's permission is required.

type.description: The entity type a module declared, e.g. `example.project`.

Session.description: What every session-establishing call returns (ADR-0018): the access token lives in memory, the refresh token in the cookie.

permissions.description: Advisory for the UI; the token carries the same list and the server checks that one.

SessionUser.description: A person as they see themselves. Email is decrypted for its owner only.

value.description: Any JSON value; null is a value, not an absence.

defaultValue.description: Any JSON value; null is a value, not an absence.

id.description: The identifier; flags have no row of their own.
The USER's id - what impersonation takes.

defaultValue.description: Any JSON value; null is a value, not an absence.

effectiveValue.description: Any JSON value; null is a value, not an absence.

id.description: The identifier; flags have no row of their own.

secret.description: `whsec_...`, shown exactly once. Encrypted at rest and never returned again.

failed.description: Jobs River discarded after their last retry.

queues.description: Jobs waiting per queue (available, scheduled or retryable).

bearer.description: A JWT from /api/auth/login (tenant) or /api/manager/login (operator), or an API key (`sk_...`).

info.description: Two realms share this API and one signing key. A token carries an `aud` claim - `tenant` for workspace members, `manager` for platform operators - and is refused outside its realm with the same 401 as no token (ADR-0019). An API key (`sk_...`) acts in the tenant realm with its own scopes.
info.title: OpenEnu API

200.description: Every key, revoked ones included; never a secret.

get.summary: This tenant's keys, newest first. Requires `api_key.view`.

post.summary: Mint a key. Requires `api_key.manage`. The secret is in this response and nowhere else, ever.

delete.summary: Revoke a key: it stops authenticating at once and stays in the list. Requires `api_key.manage`.

201.description: The stored file and a signed URL.

post.summary: Upload one file as multipart/form-data (`file`, optional `ownerType`, `ownerId`). Requires `attachment.manage`.

get.summary: The record with a fresh signed URL. Requires `attachment.view`. Another workspace's file is 404.
This workspace's trail, newest first. Requires `audit.view`.

post.summary: Send a reset link when the address is known; the answer is the same either way. Public, rate limited.

200.description: The session; Set-Cookie carries the refresh token.

post.summary: Exchange credentials for a session: the access token in the body, the refresh token as an HttpOnly cookie. Every failure is one 401. Public, rate limited.

parameters.description: The refresh token, set by login and rotated on every use.
parameters.name: open_enu_refresh

post.summary: Revoke every refresh token of the person and expire the cookie.

parameters.description: The refresh token, set by login and rotated on every use.
parameters.name: open_enu_refresh

200.description: A fresh session and a rotated cookie.

204.description: No refresh cookie was sent: there is no session to restore. Nothing is set or cleared.

post.summary: Rotate the refresh cookie and issue a new access token. A reused token revokes its whole family. No cookie at all is a 204, not a 401: a first visit asks this, and there is simply nothing to restore.

202.description: Accepted: the person must check their mail.

post.summary: Create an account and a pending workspace and send the verification link - or, for an address that has an account, mail its owner instead. The answer is the same either way. Public, rate limited.
Consume a reset token, set the password, revoke every session. Public.

parameters.description: The refresh token, set by login and rotated on every use.
parameters.name: open_enu_refresh

200.description: The session for the other workspace.

post.summary: Re-issue the session for another workspace the person belongs to. Requires the refresh cookie and a bearer token.
Consume a verification token: the account and its workspace become active. Public.

get.summary: The trail across every workspace, or one of them.
Every consultant, with the workspaces they serve.

post.summary: Operator login: the strictest rate limit in the system, no refresh, no reset, no registration.

get.summary: Every declared setting, platform-wide. Operators only.
Every workspace on the platform, newest first, with member counts.

post.summary: Create a workspace, active at once, with every module's defaults.
Add a person to a workspace, with an account if they have none. Needs a super operator.
Suspend a workspace: its members and keys stop authenticating.

delete.summary: Remove a consultant from a workspace. Needs a super operator.

put.summary: Override any setting for a workspace - the kill switch. Operators only.

post.summary: Mint a tenant-realm session for a member, marked and naming the operator (ADR-0020). Audited before the token exists.

get.summary: What is waiting and what has failed in the job queues.
Your feed, newest first, with the unread count.

post.summary: Mark everything in your feed read.
Mark one of yours read. Somebody else's is 404, not 403.

get.summary: The caller's own account. Any authenticated person; no permission.

patch.summary: Change display name or locale. Requires `identity.profile.manage`.

get.summary: One job of this workspace. Requires `progress.view`. Another workspace's job is 404.

200.description: The list envelope. The encrypted clientReference is absent here: what leaves the server is decided per endpoint.

get.summary: The tenant's projects, newest first. Requires `example.view`.

post.summary: Create a project. Requires `example.manage`. Raises `example.project.created`.

post.description: Disabled => 404, not 403: "not built yet" and "turned off after an incident" should be indistinguishable from outside. 202 rather than 200 - the work has been accepted, not done; `jobId` is what the browser watches.

202.description: Accepted: the progress id to follow and how many projects it will touch.

post.summary: Archive every active project, in the background. Requires `example.manage` and the `example.archive` flag.

200.description: The project. ETag carries the version the client now holds; it comes back as If-Match on the next write.

get.summary: One project, with its clientReference. Requires `example.view`.

patch.description: Send If-Match with the version you read. A stale one is 409 with both versions and the saved record (ConflictDetails), so the UI can offer reload or overwrite instead of losing the edit.

parameters.description: The quoted version the client holds, e.g. `"3"`.
parameters.name: If-Match

patch.summary: Rename a project. Requires `example.manage`; refused under impersonation and on an archived project.

get.summary: Full-text search across every type the caller may read. An empty query is an empty result, not everything.
This workspace's settings: every declared flag with what applies here. Requires `settings.view`.

put.summary: Override one setting for this workspace; only `tenantEditable` ones. Requires `settings.manage`.

get.summary: Every endpoint of the workspace, newest first. Never the secret.

post.summary: Register an endpoint. The secret is in this response and nowhere else, ever.

get.summary: The delivery log - the product: did you send it, and what did they say?

post.summary: Queue the same delivery again: attempts reset, the log keeps the row.

delete.summary: Deactivate - never delete: the log points at it.
